reason: ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is close to ₹16,000 in the first year, for a 3-chair parlour that runs fine on a register and WhatsApp. I don't sign up for monthly payments, and Zylu and MioSalon already sell billing apps if I ever want one, so I don't see why this one.
objection: Another monthly bill that never stops, plus ₹4,999 just to set it up. My stylists won't bother with selfies and typing numbers on a busy Sunday, and then I've paid for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a one-time or yearly price under ₹3,000, with proof from a nearby salon that it actually stopped cash going missing from the drawer.
